verdict.rationale: Google ADK's docs vaguely claim 'AI-aware developer resources' and a coding-assistant-friendly Agents CLI (google-adk-docs-9, google-adk-docs-10), but concrete probes show no llms.txt exists at the expected location, no markdown-doc variant, and no OpenAPI spec (google-adk-probe-1, google-adk-probe-2, google-adk-probe-3) — contradicting any concrete agent-consumable docs format. Missing for 10: an actual llms.txt file, machine-readable doc endpoints, or any hands-on confirmation that an agent can successfully consume ADK's docs as described.
